name: 8VIM
tagline: Type with swipes instead of tapping tiny keys
description:
8VIM turns typing into a set of simple swipe gestures, inspired by the 8pen concept and Vim's keyboard-driven editing. Instead of hunting for small keys, you glide your finger in different directions to write letters, numbers, and symbols.

It takes a bit of practice, but once it clicks, many people find it faster and more comfortable than a normal on-screen keyboard, especially for one-handed typing.
